Name: SteckNY Path Pack
Author: SteckNy
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SteckNY Path Pack[/color][/size][/heading]
Seven additional craftable paths, now with built-in seasonal artwork and optional winter snow.

Give your farm more ways to connect its gardens, buildings and open spaces. SteckNY Path Pack adds seven distinct path materials, from classic brick and grey pavers to grass joints and warm timber edging. All vanilla paths remain available.

SEASONAL ARTWORK
Four grass-based paths change through spring, summer, fall and winter. All seven materials include optional winter snow, with snow along both exposed upper and lower horizontal edges—even across wider connected paths. Connected interior seams stay clear.

Prefer the original look? Turn off Seasonal textures to use the original artwork year-round. Turn off Winter snow to keep winter grass without the snow treatment.

PREVIEW ANY SEASON
With Generic Mod Config Menu installed, open SteckNY Path Pack and choose Preview season: Auto, Spring, Summer, Fall or Winter. Leave Seasonal textures enabled, then save and close the menu to see the change. Previews change only the path artwork; your game's date and weather stay the same. Choose Auto to return to normal seasonal changes.

GMCM is optional. Every setting is also available in the mod's config.json. Content Patcher is not required.

PATHS AND RECIPES

[b]Installation[/b]
1. Close the game.
2. Extract the SteckNYPathPack folder into your game's Mods folder.
3. Launch through SMAPI and load your save.
4. Craft paths and place them like ordinary paths. Remove them with a pickaxe to recover the items.

[b]UPDATING FROM AN EARLIER VERSION[/b]
Replace the existing SteckNYPathPack folder; keep only one copy in Mods. If you installed the old separate SteckNYPathPackSeasons add-on, remove that folder. Seasonal artwork now lives inside the main mod. Keep Content Patcher if other mods need it.

All seven item IDs and recipes are unchanged from 1.0.0, so placed paths and inventory items carry over. If you used custom settings in the old seasonal add-on, reapply them in the main mod's menu or config.json.

[b]SETTINGS WITHOUT GMCM[/b]
Close the game and edit config.json in SteckNYPathPack:
EnableSeasonalTextures: true enables seasons; false restores the original artwork.
PreviewSeason: "auto", "spring", "summer", "fall", or "winter".
WinterSnow: true adds winter snow; false uses the snow-free winter appearance.

[b]COMPATIBILITY AND NOTES[/b]
The pack adds its own paths and recipes without replacing vanilla items or textures. Vanilla path recolors can remain installed. Each material connects to itself.

In Auto mode, outdoor paths follow the local season. Indoors, Ginger Island and the Desert use summer artwork. A fixed preview overrides these choices. Crafting icons remain unchanged so items are easy to identify.
